CustomField.description: Weighted score for Does the customer have a budget for this purchase ?
CustomField.formula: CASE( Customer_budget__c , "Yes", 2, "Looks like, but not sure", 1, "Not available, as of now", 0, "Customer not sharing", -1, 0 ) * 0.07*100
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Weighted score for Does the customer have a budget for this purchase ?
CustomField.label: Customer Budget Score
